newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end steady after early panic.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end steady after early panic.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates finished unchanged at Thursday's 21.75 percent closing level on Friday after a brief panic surge in early trade, dealers said.
"Wanton panic caused an unfounded rate surge in early trading," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
Overnight rates surged to between 23.50 and 24 percent in the first 20 minutes of trading, but fell back to 21.50 to 22 percent as quckly as they rose, he added.
Two or three major banks sought to square positions ahead of the weekend and Monday's tax payment but as they were done, the market returned to normal trade, Tolonics said.
